llm.summary: This website-builder is purpose-aligned, but it combines one-prompt automatic cloud deployment with under-declared sensitive credentials and payment/database capabilities.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent: generate and deploy full-stack EdgeOne Pages sites, including e-commerce, AI chat, and admin dashboards. Those capabilities are high-impact but broadly aligned with the description.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill advertises that a user can state a need in one sentence and the AI will automatically deploy the full site; the provided artifacts do not show a clear staging, confirmation, rollback, or scope boundary before publishing.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files to execute, but SKILL.md references a large generated project structure that cannot be statically reviewed in the supplied artifact set.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md declares secret environment variables for JWT signing, AI APIs, payment identifiers, and database access, while the registry requirements say no required env vars or primary credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The design uses persistent stores such as KV, D1, sessions, localStorage, cart/order data, and AI history. This is expected for the purpose, but users should define retention and access controls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Use this only after you are ready to review generated code and explicitly approve any deployment. Start with non-production EdgeOne/payment/database credentials, deploy to staging first, and verify privacy, authentication, payment, and rollback behavior before exposing the site publicly.

evidence.explanation: This describes automatic publication of generated full-stack code to a cloud hosting platform after minimal user input. Deployment is purpose-aligned, but it is a high-impact action and the visible artifacts do not define an approval, staging, rollback, or containment step.
evidence.snippet: 用户说一句话，AI 生成完整前后端网站，自动部署到 EdgeOne Pages。

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Require explicit user confirmation before deployment, prefer staging first, review generated files and environment variables, and document rollback/removal steps.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A casual website-building request could lead to a public deployment or cloud account changes before the user has reviewed the generated code and configuration.

evidence.explanation: The skill declares sensitive secrets for authentication, AI provider access, payment integration, and database access. Registry metadata separately says required env vars and primary credentials are none, so the sensitive credential requirements are under-declared.
evidence.snippet: JWT_SECRET ... required: true ... secret: true; AI_API_KEY ... secret: true; WX_APPID ... secret: true; WX_MCHID ... secret: true; DATABASE_URL ... secret: true

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Treat these as high-value credentials, use least-privilege and project-scoped secrets, avoid production payment/database credentials until reviewed, and update metadata to accurately declare required and optional credentials.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Users may not realize before installation that the workflow can involve authentication secrets, payment provider configuration, AI keys, and database connection material.

evidence.explanation: The artifact set contains only SKILL.md, while the instructions describe many templates, functions, utilities, and references. This is acceptable for an instruction-only skill, but the actual generated implementation and dependencies are not reviewable here.
evidence.snippet: No code files present — this is an instruction-only skill. The regex-based scanner had nothing to analyze.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review the generated project, dependencies, deployment configuration, and payment/auth code before publishing or connecting real credentials.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The clean static scan does not prove the generated website code is safe, because there was no runnable code included in the scan.

evidence.explanation: The proposed website architecture stores or reads session, cart, order, local browser storage, and AI conversation history. This is coherent for an e-commerce/AI site, but it involves persistent user data.
evidence.snippet: KV session 验证 ... Cart、Orders 读、AI History 读 ... localStorage 封装

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Define retention, deletion, access control, and privacy behavior before production use, especially for AI chat history and order/customer data.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Customer sessions, shopping activity, orders, and AI chat history may persist in storage if the generated site is deployed as designed.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The main concern is automatic cloud deployment of generated full-stack code without visible approval or rollback boundaries; missing code also limits implementation review.

permission_boundary.summary: The skill expects sensitive auth, AI, payment, and database secrets, but registry metadata does not declare required credentials or env vars.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The generated architecture intentionally persists sessions, carts, orders, and AI history, so privacy and retention controls should be reviewed.
